neighbours.label: anger: the onset of an anger word (rage, fury, wrath, loathing, 'angry about')
fire: When he read the unfair verdict he was filled with rage and could not speak.
The crowd responded to the announcement with fury and loud shouting.
She felt a cold wrath building inside her as the lies continued.
Many voters are furious about the sudden tax increase.
His face turned red with anger when he saw the broken window.
The villagers looked at the tax collector with open hatred and loathing.
There is a lot to be angry about in the way the factory was closed.
He slammed the door, seething with resentment and indignation.
quiet: When he read the surprising verdict he was filled with relief and could not speak.
The crowd responded to the announcement with cheers and loud applause.
She felt a quiet sadness building inside her as the evening went on.
Many voters are curious about the sudden tax change.
His face turned red with embarrassment when he dropped the cake.
The villagers looked at the new teacher with open curiosity and warmth.
There is a lot to be proud of in the way the factory was rebuilt.
He closed the door gently, humming with contentment and calm.
